review.why: The transfer preserves Frame Shift’s relationships rather than copying an unrelated fixture layout. The cover is approximately 448×300px with restrained corners; the business identity is prominent without becoming a theatrical hero. Supporting text is muted and readable, verification is expressed literally, and ordinary information has no floating-card shadows. The Recreate source begins at y=114 and its commitment at y=138, preserving the desktop 24px shift. Its payment is large, stationary and explicitly conditional. The Story remains an intact approximately 144×256px supplied sheet, with eligibility and payout outside the artwork. Navigation labels, campaign inspection, work links and Save controls remain visible without clipping. No concrete implementation drift or capture-visible functional regression warrants a fix.
review.verdict: Yes—Frame Shift was faithfully transferred to this public business profile, with its real records and visible functionality preserved, and this desktop viewport is ready for visual sign-off.
